name: Weave
tagline: MCP-Native Agent Eval vs Decorator-Instrumented Agent Observability Platform
oneLine: An observability and evaluation platform from Weights & Biases that helps you track, evaluate, and improve your agents and LLM applications.
tldrVendor: Weave is Weights & Biases' observability and evaluation platform for agents and LLM applications, integrated through a Python or TypeScript SDK with @weave.op decorators. It traces calls with token usage and cost, runs evaluations with custom or predefined scorers, versions prompts, and can trace MCP servers and clients; W&B announced its acquisition by CoreWeave on 2025-05-05.

rows.vendor: Python/TypeScript SDK: install weave, call weave.init, add @weave.op to functions; supported LLM clients auto-tracked
rows.quote: Add the @weave.op() decorator to functions you want to track

rows.vendor: Self-managed: Kubernetes 1.29+, Helm, ClickHouse, S3-compatible storage, existing W&B Platform, Weave-enabled license
rows.quote: W&B license: Weave-enabled license from W&B Support

rows.vendor: In-process SDK: after importing and initializing weave inside your code, it records each request as a Call
rows.quote: After you import the Weave SDK into your code and initialize it with weave.init, Weave records each request as a Call with inputs, outputs, latency, token usage, and cost.

rows.vendor: Evaluation over a Dataset with scorers: function-based, Scorer class, LLM-as-a-judge, predefined and local SLM scorers
rows.quote: Although this guide shows you how to create custom scorers, Weave comes with predefined scorers and local SLM scorers that you can use right away

rows.vendor: Automatic token usage and cost per call for supported providers; custom per-token costs; not in the TypeScript SDK
rows.quote: Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call

rows.vendor: Traces MCP servers and clients (patches FastMCP and ClientSession); W&B also ships an MCP server to query Weave traces
rows.quote: The Weave integration works with both the MCP server and client.

rows.vendor: Weave SDK is Apache-2.0; the hosted platform and the self-managed server require a license from W&B
Built by Weights & Biases; CoreWeave completed its acquisition of Weights & Biases on 2025-05-05
rows.quote: We are thrilled to share that we have completed our acquisition of Weights & Biases.

rows.vendor: Web UI with trace tree and calls table; Signals score every production trace automatically with 13 preset signals (monitors are the previous approach)
rows.quote: For new implementations, use Signals under Weave for Agents.

rows.vendor: OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Google, Mistral, LiteLLM; LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, DSPy, OpenAI and Claude Agent SDKs
rows.quote: Weave integrates with these frameworks to trace the entire pipeline

rows.vendor: Prompt objects (StringPrompt, MessagesPrompt) published with weave.publish and versioned on the project's Prompts page
rows.quote: When you publish a prompt with weave.publish, it appears in your Weave project on the Prompts page

rows.vendor: ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA; SSO via OIDC, LDAP or SAML; SaaS, dedicated cloud, customer-managed
rows.quote: We are certified under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, and ISO/IEC 27018:2019, and remain compliant with SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA standards.

rows.vendor: Free $0/mo for personal use; Pro starts at $60/month billed monthly, Weave data ingestion billed in arrears; Enterprise custom; self-hosting needs a license

vendorReasons.text: You need LLM tracing and evaluation in the same platform as model experiment tracking (W&B Models).
You need a prompt playground and leaderboards to compare evaluation runs side by side.
You need auto-instrumented tracing across many providers and frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI and the OpenAI Agents SDK.
You need pre-built scorers for toxicity, bias, PII detection and hallucinations out of the box.
You need an enterprise deployment with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA compliance, including dedicated cloud or customer-managed options.

faq.question: What is the difference between Iris and Weave?
faq.vendorPart: Weave is Weights & Biases' observability and evaluation platform for agents and LLM applications. You instrument Python or TypeScript code with the weave SDK and @weave.op decorators, and it records traces, runs evaluations with scorers, and tracks token usage and cost.

faq.question: Is Iris better than Weave for MCP agent evaluation?
faq.vendorPart: Weave offers things Iris does not: a prompt playground, leaderboards, pre-built scorers for toxicity, bias, PII and hallucinations, and a self-managed enterprise deployment on Kubernetes under a W&B license.

sources.label: CoreWeave: acquisition of Weights & Biases completed
